name: bedside-lamp
prompt: A die-cut sticker in full colour, centred on a flat, completely uniform pure magenta #FF00FF background. The magenta must be solid edge to edge with no shading, no gradient, no texture and no vignette. Do NOT draw a checkerboard or any other transparency pattern — paint real magenta. A clean white border traces the outermost edge of the sticker and nothing extends past it; where the sticker itself is a card, a sign or a patch, that shape is the sticker and the white border traces its edge. No magenta or hot pink anywhere in the art itself. Subject: A bedside lamp switched on, pleated fabric shade, turned wooden neck, small round base, a pull cord hanging. Rendered as a vintage offset-litho illustration on card: confident inked linework, flat colours printed very slightly off-register, a fine dot screen doing the shading, the ink sun-faded and the surface lightly worn. Palette: butter-yellow shade, brass fittings, warm cream glow. One subject only, centred, filling the frame. No drop shadow, no scenery, no second object, no text or lettering.
